Asset type: original pixel-art visual novel character master reference, NOT final separated layers.
Reference image: use only the attached original project's young male hero for identity, costume and pixel art style. Redraw him standing naturally, three-quarter front view facing camera, both arms relaxed beside torso, entire body including shoes. Tall exaggerated black pompadour hairstyle, thick dark eyebrows, young male face, black open school uniform jacket with gold buttons, red undershirt, silver chain and rectangular silver pendant, black trousers and black-white sneakers. Calm neutral expression, closed mouth. Keep crisp visible pixel clusters and limited shaded pixel-art, not smooth anime painting.
Transparent background. EXACT canvas 1024x1536, no text, no sheet border. Character centered at x=512. Hair top y=80, chin y=390, shoulders at y=430, waist at y=850, feet at y=1480. Keep arms and legs naturally separated enough to see silhouette. No props. This reference will be used for individually registered body/head/hair/eye/mouth/arm layers, so anatomy should be complete and clear. No background pixels, no floor, no cast shadow. Do not copy the fighting pose of the reference.
